node: Defense subtier components and qualified industrial suppliers
summary: Layer 1B expands the defense-subtier supplier node into a compact two-lane universe. The reference lane uses TransDigm as a visible benchmark for proprietary, hard-to-substitute aerospace and defense components. The underfollowed lane prioritizes smaller US-listed manufacturers whose public labels are industrial, aerospace materials, electronics, or engineered-products rather than pure-play defense primes. The chokepoint hypothesis remains that DoD and prime-contractor demand may be constrained by qualified processes, certified production, long program qualification cycles, cleared or controlled work, and supplier willingness to carry uneven defense volumes.
